evals.prompt: Write unit tests for this PasswordValidator class.
evals.expected_output: A break-vector list first, then tests with one distinct angle each.
expectations: Shows the break-vector list before any test, each marked kept or skipped with reason
Covers boundaries, emoji or non-ASCII input and empty input from the catalogue
Does not add several tests that fail on the same one-line change

evals.prompt: Unit test this ViewModel that loads from a repository and restores from SavedStateHandle.
evals.expected_output: Tests using a fake repository, runTest and a SavedStateHandle restoration case.
expectations: Uses a hand-written fake repository, not mocks with verify on call patterns
Uses runTest with a main dispatcher set, with no Thread.sleep or real delay

evals.prompt: Review these tests and tell me what edge cases I am missing.
evals.expected_output: A report of missing vectors and redundant pairs by name.
expectations: Names missing break vectors from the contract
Flags tests written from the implementation instead of the contract
